<reasoning>
The shared-memory weight tile is loaded by all 256 threads in the block, so its channel base must be determined by `block_k`, not by each thread group’s `k0`. Using `k0` causes the second 128-thread group to overwrite shared-memory entries with weights from channels beyond the block’s intended 8-channel tile. Replace the global channel calculation so the tile consistently contains channels `block_k * OUT_K` through `block_k * OUT_K + OUT_K - 1`. The computation-side `k0` indexing remains unchanged.
</reasoning>
